sn35.158:1.1: cakkhuṃ bhikkhave yoniso manasikarotha cakkhuaniccatañca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassatha.
sn35.158:1.2: cakkhuṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu yoniso manasikaronto cakkhuaniccatañca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassanto cakkhusmiṃpi nibbindati
sn35.158:1.8: jivhaṃ bhikkhave yoniso manasikarotha jivhāniccatañca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassatha.
sn35.158:1.9: jivhaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu yoniso manasikaronto jivhāniccatañca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassanto jivhāyapi nibbindati
sn35.158:1.14: manaṃ bhikkhave yoniso manasikarotha manāniccatañca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassatha.
sn35.158:1.15: manaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu yoniso manasikaronto manāniccatañca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassanto manasmiṃpi nibbindati
